sources.title: Visiting Huaqing Palace: Suggestions from a Local Guide
sources.content:
Huaqing Palace: Complete Information Guide

Overview
Huaqing Palace, also called Huaqing Pool, is "one of the Four Great Royal Gardens in China" alongside the Summer Palace, Old Summer Palace, and Chengde Mountain Resort. Located 40-50 minutes from downtown Xi'an, this historic site combines natural hot springs with significant historical events.

Historical Significance
The palace bears witness to the Tang Dynasty romance between Emperor Li Longji and concubine Yang Yuhuan, who "bathed there for 8 years." Most notably, the Xi'an Incident occurred here on December 12, 1936, when Chiang Kai-shek was arrested at the Five-Room Hall.

Visiting Information
Hours: 7:30am to 6:30pm
Admission: 120 yuan
Recommended Duration: Approximately 2 hours
Distance: 35 kilometers (22 miles) from Xi'an urban area

Main Attractions
Huan Garden & Five-Room Hall: Features pavilions and flowing water; housed historical figures including "Empress Dowager Cixi and Chiang Kai-shek." Bullet marks remain from the Xi'an Incident.

Royal Hot Spring Pool Museum: Displays "remains of five Tang Dynasty royal hot spring pools" including those used by emperors and Yang Yuhuan. Visitors can experience the actual hot spring water source.

Li-Yang Love Story Sites: Includes Frost Flying Hall, Nine-Dragon Lake, and Longevity Hall—locations associated with the imperial romance.

Lishan Mountain: Accessible via cable car; offers panoramic views of the palace and surrounding region.

Performances
"Song of Everlasting Regret" is a 70-minute evening performance featuring "song and dance drama" against natural backdrops. Tickets range from 248-988 yuan. An immersive historical performance about the Xi'an Incident is also available.

Best Times to Visit
Spring (March-May) and autumn (September-November) offer optimal weather, with temperatures between 15-25°C (59-77°F). Arriving at opening time minimizes crowds.

Transportation
Metro Line 9 reaches Huaqing Pool Station; private car rental is recommended for comfort. The site is 14 kilometers from the Terracotta Army Museum.

Hot Spring Facilities
Visitors may soak feet within the palace but cannot bathe. Nearby hotels offer hot spring bathing (200-500 yuan) for a complete experience.

sources.title: Huaqing Palace in Xian: History, Location, Entrance Fee
sources.content:
Huaqing Palace: Complete Information Summary

Overview
Huaqing Palace represents an imperial bathing site from China's Tang Dynasty, discovered in 1982 and opened to the public in 1990. The site integrates "historic relics, garden landscapes and performances."

Historical Background
The hot spring location has undergone four major construction periods spanning over 3,000 years, from the Western Zhou Dynasty through the Tang Dynasty. Emperor Xuanzong significantly expanded the facility during his reign, creating the luxurious retreat known today.

Key Attractions
Main features include five sets of hot spring pool ruins: the Pool of Stars, Prince Pool, Lotus Pool, and Imperial Consort Pool. Notable structures comprise the Nine Dragon Pool, Flying Frost Hall, and Drying Hair Pavilion, where "the Imperial Consort Yang finished her bath, she would come to dry up her hair while enjoying the scenery."

Practical Details
Location: 38 North Huqing Road, Lintong District, Xi'an
Hours: Summer 7:30 AM–6:00 PM; Winter 7:30 AM–5:30 PM
Admission: 120 CNY per person
Time Required: Approximately 3 hours
Access: Metro Line 9 to Huaqing Pool Station, 3-minute walk

The Everlasting Sorrow Performance
An outdoor dance-drama runs April–October, featuring 70-minute shows at multiple times. Ticket prices range from 228–988 CNY depending on seating area and session timing.

Romance & Legend
The site's fame derives largely from the tragic love story of Emperor Xuanzong and Consort Yang Yuhuan, immortalized in the classical poem "The Song of Everlasting Sorrow."

Visitor Tips
Best seasons: Spring and autumn
Arrive early to avoid crowds
Combine with nearby Terracotta Army (9 km away)
Second performance session offers optimal audio-visual experience
Book shows in advance online

sources.title: Huaqing Hot Springs and Ancient Baths: Must-See Highlights and Travel Tips
sources.content:
Huaqing Hot Springs and Ancient Baths: Must-See Highlights and Travel Tips

Upon arrival at the scenic area, you will be amazed by the imperial hot spring pool sites, ancient-style buildings, and attractive lake and mountain views, with staff members and tourists wearing traditional Chinese costumes, making you feel like traveling through time to the prosperous Tang Dynasty.

Inside Huaqing Palace, there are five hot spring pools remaining: the Lotus Pool, Haitang Pool, Star Pool, Shangshi Pool, and the Prince Pool, with the Lotus Pool being Emperor Xuanzong's private bathing pool.

The romance between Emperor Xuanzong and his consort Yang Guifei is arguably the most famous story, with Yang Guifei being his beloved concubine for whom he renovated Huaqing Palace, and it was recorded that Emperor Xuanzong came to the palace over 36 times during his 44-year reign.

On December 12, 1936, the Xi'an Incident, which shocked China and the world, took place there when Chiang Kai-shek, the chairman of the Kuomintang, was arrested in the Five-Room Hall of Huaqing Palace.

There are often large-scale cultural performances held in Huaqing Palace, which vividly present the history and culture of the Tang Dynasty, including the love story of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei, combining dance, music, and drama elements.

Free courses in intangible cultural heritage experiences have been offered, including stone rubbing, woodblock New Year paintings, and plant dyeing using grass and trees.

Spring and autumn are the best seasons to visit, with mild weather and beautiful gardens.

The most convenient public transportation is to take Metro Line 9 and arrive at Huaqingchi Station, then walk to the scenic spot in 3 minutes.

sources.title: Huaqing Palace Tickets Booking, Price, Opening Hours
sources.content:
Huaqing Palace Tickets, Hours, and How to Visit

Opening Hours & Tickets
Huaqing Palace is open from 07:30 - 19:10 daily, with garden clearance at 19:00.

How to Visit
By Metro: The most convenient public transportation is to take Metro Line 9 and arrive at Huaqingchi Station, exit B and C, and walk to the scenic spot in 3 minutes.

By Bus: From Xi'an Railway Station, take Tourist bus No. 5 (No. 306), No. 914 or No. 915 directly to Huaqingchi Station, which takes about 1 hour and costs less than CNY 10.

By Taxi: Taxi will cost about CNY 100 and take about 1 hour if setting out from city center (Bell Tower).

Booking Information
You can book and pay online, get confirmation by email. For Chinese ID cards holders, you can scan ID card to get into the site, while passport holders need to redeem paper tickets. You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund.

Time to Spend
It's recommended to allocate at least 3 to 4 hours to fully appreciate Huaqing Palace's historical sites and beautiful gardens.

Additional Attractions
The famous show "Song of Everlasting Sorrow" is performed every year from April 1st to October 31st, and each performance lasts about 70 minutes.

Combined ticket for Huaqing Palace & Mount Li is CNY 120.

sources.title: Huaqing Palace (2026) - All You MUST Know Before You Go
sources.content:
Huaqing Palace - TripAdvisor Visitor Information

The opening hours last from 10:00 to 22:00, and admissions stop at 21:00. Combined ticket for Huaqing Palace & Mount Li is CNY 120.

The suggested visit duration is 2-3 hours. Major highlights include:

Hot Spring Pools: There are five hot spring pools remaining: the Lotus Pool, Haitang Pool, Star Pool, Shangshi Pool, and the Prince Pool. The Lotus Pool was Emperor Xuanzong's private bathing pool.

Mount Li: I recommend taking the cableway to go up the mountain. After getting out at the upper station of the cableway, you could walk for about 15 minutes to the two viewing platforms of Laomu Hall and Beacon Tower to enjoy the scenery.

The Song of Everlasting Sorrow: Don't miss the spectacular "Song of Everlasting Sorrow" dance performance, a journey back to the Tang Dynasty.

Book in Advance: Booking tickets in advance is highly recommended, especially during peak tourist seasons or holidays, to avoid long queues.

Best Time to Visit: Summer can be extremely hot and humid, but the scenery is still breathtaking. Consider visiting early in the morning or later in the afternoon to avoid the peak heat and larger tour groups.

Combination with Terracotta Army: The Terracotta Army is only about 10 minutes' drive away, so they are usually arranged in one day. The common itinerary is to visit the Terracotta Army in the morning and the Huaqing Palace in the afternoon.

Guides: Official guides are available for hire at Huaqing Palace. You can also hire guides outside the entrance, but be prepared for potential haggling.

sources.title: 华清池（陕西省西安市的遗址遗迹类旅游景点）_百度百科
sources.content:
华清池/华清宫 完整信息提取

基本概况
华清池，又名华清宫，位于陕西省西安市临潼区，西距西安30公里。这是一处著名的温泉汤池遗址，南依骊山，北面渭水，与兵马俑相邻。

地理位置与气候
地理位置陕西省西安市临潼区，属于暖温带半湿润大陆性季风气候。年平均气温13℃。

开放信息
旺季（3月-11月）：7:00-19:00，门票150元/人
淡季（12月-次年2月）：7:30-18:30，门票120元/人

历史沿革

历代营造
温泉利用历史悠久。周幽王在位期间，此地就发现了温泉，修有骊宫。周代名"星辰汤"，秦始皇时期改为"骊山汤"，汉武帝扩建成离宫。隋文帝开皇三年（583年）列植松柏千株，修屋建宇。

唐代是发展高峰。唐贞观十八年（644年）建汤泉宫，咸亨二年（671年）改名温泉宫。唐玄宗时期大规模扩建，治汤井为池，环山列宫殿，始称华清宫。

1878年，临潼县令沈家桢修建环园，历时一年的修建，园内亭台楼榭，雕梁画栋，山环水绕。

主要景点

骊山温泉
中国已知温泉达2700多处，独华清池温泉以芳香凝脂、动人故事名冠诸泉之首。温泉水温常年43℃，含二氧化硅、氟离子等矿物质。每小时流量113吨，对风湿、关节炎有疗效。

唐代浴池遗址
发现于1982年，包括：
莲花汤（御汤）：玄宗皇帝沐浴处
海棠汤（贵妃池）：杨贵妃专用浴池，花朵一样的浴池中沐浴了近十个春秋
星辰汤：唐太宗专用
太子汤、尚食汤等

九龙湖
面积为530平方米的人工湖，分成上下两个湖，中间有长堤（九龙桥）东西横贯。湖畔建有飞霜殿、宜春殿等仿唐建筑。

五间厅（西安事变遗址）
建于清末，1936年蒋介石两次下榻于此。12月12日发动兵谏后，玻璃窗、墙壁上迄今还保留有西安事变兵谏发生激战时的弹痕。

芙蓉园
2000年立项，2005年建成开放，包括长生殿、芙蓉湖、骊岫飞泉、羡鱼亭、桃花谷等景观。

梨园
唐玄宗建立的中国第一所皇家音乐艺术学校，把梨园作为音乐、舞蹈、戏剧活动的中心。

唐代水井
园内现存的唯一一口唐代水井遗址，距今已有1,300年历史，深8.3米。

人文历史

唐玄宗与杨贵妃
唐天宝六年（747）扩建后，唐玄宗每年携带杨贵妃到此过冬沐浴。白居易《长恨歌》记述：春寒赐浴华清池，温泉水滑洗凝脂。侍儿扶起娇无力，始是新承恩泽时。

唐玄宗从开元二年（714年）到天宝十四年（755年）的41年时间里，先后来此达36次。

古代诗文记载
清人钱维乔《华清宫》诗云：华清之宫骊山足，玉殿千重相连属。唐诗人白居易《骊宫高》诗曰：高高骊山上有宫，朱楼紫殿三四重。

景区规模
华清宫范围包括：南至骊山西绣岭第一峰（周烽火台），北到县城北，东至石瓮谷，西到牡丹沟。建筑布局严谨，曲折萦回，规模宏大，主要殿舍以温泉为中心。

现代发展
1959年进行大规模扩建。现已成为集文物、园林、沐浴、娱乐为一体的景区，包括：唐华清宫御汤遗址博物馆、西安事变旧址、九龙湖与芙蓉湖风景区、唐梨园遗址博物馆、飞霜殿、昭阳殿、长生殿等建筑群。

荣誉称号
2007年被评为全国首批5A级旅游景区，获得中国唐宫文化旅游标志性景区等称号。

sources.title: 西安华清宫游玩攻略 - 携程攻略
sources.content:
华清宫游玩攻略

门票信息
华清宫景区门票价格为120元。身高1.2米以下儿童、年满65周岁老人、现役军人、残疾人等可享受免票政策；18周岁以下学生持有效学生证可享受半价优惠。

演出信息
华清宫《长恨歌》门票价格根据座位区域划分，最低238元起，每年3月底—10月底，12月初—2月底上演，每场演出时长70分钟。

华清宫还有《1212西安事变》大型实景影画，陕西人特惠票为99元/人。

游玩攻略
推荐游玩路线包括：线路一为探古迹-赏骊山风光-观看演出；线路二为触摸历史-观看演出-兵谏亭。

交通信息
华清宫景区位于西安市临潼区骊山北华清路38号，可乘坐地铁9号线前往，或乘坐游5专线（306路）、915路、914路到达。

2026年信息
2026元旦华清宫唐潮盛典活动提供背诗免门票、唐风妆造、戏唐游艺等体验项目。

sources.title: Visit Huaqing Palace: The Silk Road's Secret Hot Springs Loved by Yang Guifei
sources.content:
Visit Huaqing Palace: The Silk Road's Secret Hot Springs Loved by Yang Guifei – Tang Culture & Xi'an Travel Experience

A travel blog post discussing Huaqing Palace's hot springs in Xi'an, with connections to the historical figure Yang Guifei, proximity to the Terracotta Army, Tang Dynasty cultural significance, and travel experience recommendations. The palace is known as one of the Silk Road's treasured sites, featuring ancient hot springs that have been used for over 3,000 years. The article covers the romantic history between Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei, practical visiting advice, and how to combine the visit with nearby attractions like the Terracotta Warriors Museum.
